title: AI News Daily — July 25, 2026
summary: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta, and two dozen other companies signed an open letter urging Washington not to restrict open-weight AI models — with OpenAI and Anthropic conspicuously absent — just a day after the White House accused a Chinese lab of distilling Anthropic's models via banned chips; meanwhile Anthropic launched a cheaper Opus 5 that beats its own flagship on several benchmarks, and Hugging Face revealed it fought off an OpenAI-model-driven breach using a Chinese open model because US guardrails got in the way.
